Use a Stat or a Summary strip for one headline figure, a Progress for a single bar. Height: grows with its rows (about 64px a row, 76px with captions)

ShadSchedule.name: ShadSchedule
ShadSchedule.description: Resource schedule: resources down the side (rooms, desks, people on shift or on call, vehicles, equipment) and time across, with bookings drawn as blocks. scale 'hours' shows one day (date, empty for today) from dayStart to dayEnd (hours, 0 to 24) with empty slots of slotMinutes: a one-day room or resource board is scale 'hours' (days is not read; scale 'days' with days 1 draws the same hours). scale 'days' is the multi-day overview: `days` days from date, a column a day (a week of shifts, an on-call rota), each booking filling its day. resources: ['Atlas', 'Cove'] or [{ id, name, caption, avatar }] (empty: the distinct values of the bookings' resourceField). bookings: rows read through startField and endField (an ISO date-time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm', 'HH:mm' for a time on the shown day, or 'YYYY-MM-DD' for a whole day; no end lasts an hour), resourceField (a resource's id or name), titleField, subtitleField (a second line: the host, the person) and statusField (toned by its words: Confirmed green, Tentative or Pending amber, Cancelled red, Booked blue; or a tone name success | warning | danger | info | neutral. There are no other colours: a colour word such as purple shows the accent). Overlapping bookings of one resource stack in lanes. A now-line marks the current time on today (showNowLine). A click on a booking exposes selectedBooking (its row) and selectedBookingId and fires onBookingClicked; a click on an empty slot exposes selectedSlot { resourceId, resource, start and end (ISO date-times: prefill a date-time field from start), date ('YYYY-MM-DD'), startTime and endTime ('HH:mm' text, not a date), label } and fires onSlotClicked (open a booking form from it). hourFormat 12h or 24h; resourceTitle heads the resource column. A long hour range or short slots scroll sideways inside the widget rather than squeeze (each slot at least 28px, the shortest booking 40px), the resource column staying put; a short booking's full title is in its tooltip. Height: grows with its rows (40px header plus rowHeight, default 56, per resource; more where bookings overlap)

ShadTable.name: ShadTable
ShadTable.description: Superseded for new builds: use Table with styles.tableLook "shadcn" (ToolJet's own Table drawn in the look, with every Table feature and convention). Kept so existing apps keep working. Data table: typed columns (text, number, currency, date, badge, tags, boolean, link, image, avatar, progress, buttons), search, sort, filters, pagination (client or server side), single or bulk selection, inline editing with save/discard, CSV export, column chooser. Native Table conventions

properties.label: Columns (empty: from the data)
properties.default: {{[{ key: 'name', name: 'Name' }, { key: 'status', name: 'Status', columnType: 'badge' }, { key: 'date', name: 'Date', columnType: 'date' }, { key: 'amount',…

table.columns: properties.columns: [{ key, name, columnType }]. columnType: string (default), number, currency, date, datetime, badge (status chips; badgeColors per column or table-wide, or options [{value,label}]), tags (array or comma list), boolean, link (displayText, linkTarget), image (imageShape round|square), avatar (a name or {name, src}), progress (maxValue), button (buttons: [{ id, label, variant default|outline|secondary|ghost|destructive }]), json, html. Per column: horizontalAlignment, columnSize (px), decimalPlaces, currency, dateFormat, prefix, suffix, columnVisibility, sortable, isEditable, wrap, fontWeight. Per-row styling is data, never a nested binding (a {{ }} inside the columns binding breaks it): conditionalStyles: [{ condition, value, textColor, backgroundColor, fontWeight }] (first match wins; conditions as filters: equals, ne, contains, gt, lt, gte, lte, isEmpty, ...; add key to test another field of the row). A button's disabledWhen / hiddenWhen: { key, condition, value }. Empty columns are generated from the data.
table.selection: allowSelection (single; selectedRow, selectedRowId = data index), showBulkSelector (checkbox column; selectedRows, selectedRowsId), highlightSelectedRow, disableRowDeselection, defaultSelectedRow {key: value}. onRowClicked fires after selectedRow is set; onSelectionChanged on any selection change. Row ids come from idField (default id), so a selection survives a refetch.
table.actions: A button column fires onActionButtonClicked after setting lastActionClicked { buttonId, columnKey, row } and selectedRow to that row: one event handler serves every button, branching on components.<table>.lastActionClicked.buttonId.
table.serverSide: Server-side pagination: serverSidePagination true, data is the current page, bind the query offset to components.<table>.pageIndex (1-based) and rowsPerPage, set totalRecords for page numbers (or toggle enableNextButton), refetch onPageChanged. serverSideSearch / serverSideSort / serverSideFilter stop the table filtering, sorting or searching locally: read searchText, sortApplied [{column, columnKey, direction}] and filters [{column, condition, value}] in the query and refetch on onSearch / onSort / onFilterChanged (each resets pageIndex to 1 except sort). setPage does not fire onPageChanged.
table.editing: isEditable columns edit in place: changeSet {dataIndex: {key: value}}, dataUpdates (full edited rows), updatedData; onCellValueChanged per edit; the Save changes bar fires onBulkUpdate (save there, then refetch: edits clear when the data changes); Discard fires onCancelChanges.
table.chrome: Toolbar: displaySearchBox, showFilterButton, hideColumnSelectorButton (false shows the column chooser), showDownloadButton (CSV/JSON of the filtered, sorted, edited rows), showRefreshButton (onRefresh). cellSize condensed|regular|spacious, tableType regular|striped|bordered, stickyHeader. More than 150 rows on a page are virtualised. Styles: accent, background, header background/text, cell text, secondary text, border, hover, selected, striped, radius, font size, header casing, outer border.
